name: Deals filter drawer applies a deal type and exposes the active filter
description:
1. Sign in and open Deals.
2. Open Filter and choose the confirmed New Deal option.
3. Apply the filter.
4. Verify the drawer closes and the active filter is shown with a settled grid.
